title: Permuted rotor loops beyond Jenzer (2026): resolving Remark 5.5 (arXiv:2610.21593v1, p. 19)
topic: Jenzer's permuted rotor-loop formula without the star condition, Remark 5.5, arXiv:2610.21593v1, page 19

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Extending Jenzer's (2026) same-order and star-family proofs, we resolve his Remark 5.5 (arXiv:2610.21593v1, p. 19): every return permutation satisfies the rotor-loop subset formula for every anticommuting unit bivector family, without the star condition. Conjugation eliminates every off-diagonal scalar contribution except possibly complementary subsets when the family size is odd. Their total vanishes because a balanced product in an exterior algebra has even degree. Corollaries give mixed-sign compact and zero formulas, the exact chain correction, and the range and separability of every return order. For at most three factors the loop has only scalar and simple bivector parts, and every scalar power is a Chebyshev polynomial of its scalar part.
summary: Extending Jenzer (2026), the note proves his numerical-evidence assertion for all square-minus-one anticommuting bivector families and all return permutations in finite-dimensional nondegenerate real Clifford algebras. Written proofs also settle the three-factor simplicity and power observations in Section 8.4, give mixed-sign formulas, and characterize permutation-dependent range and separability. Exact finite coefficient and rational checks accompany the proofs; only the square-minus-one subset formula is the scope of the linked main Lean declaration. The companion Lean declarations cover scalar cyclicity, trace support and odd exterior coefficient cancellation.
